trigger_cases.query: Read the balance of an address on mainnet.
Send a transaction from the command line.
Look up a contract's ABI on Etherscan.
Convert wei to ether in the shell.
Sign a message with my local keystore account.
Read a storage slot from a deployed contract.
Compute the keccak256 of this string from the CLI.
Resolve an ENS name from the command line.
Write a Forge test for the transfer function.
Start a local node and impersonate an account.
Write a Solidity contract for staking.
Explain how the EVM stack machine works.
Set up CI for my repository.
Deploy my contract with forge script.
Write a React hook for wallet connection.

output_cases.prompt: Explain how to decode transaction calldata for a transfer(address,uint256) call using cast.
assertions: The answer uses cast decode-calldata or cast 4byte-calldata for the selector.
The answer names cast calldata or cast abi-encode for the encoding side.

output_cases.prompt: Show the cast commands to read a storage slot and the ETH balance of a contract at a given address.
assertions: The answer uses cast storage for the slot.
The answer uses cast balance for the balance.

output_cases.prompt: Sign a message with a local keystore account and verify the signature.
assertions: The answer uses cast wallet sign.
The answer checks the signature with cast wallet verify or an equivalent recovery step.
